canada.summary: In Canada, Nov. 15 to 21 is National Addictions Awareness Week, and CBC has gathered stories from northerners who have faced addiction, and workers who support them. They’ve shared their stories, and the unique obstacles they faced to get to where they are today.

canada.title: Non-profit unveils plans for up to 16 affordable homes in Haines Junction
canada.summary: A Yukon non-profit wants to build up to 16 affordable homes in Haines Junction, but the proposed development would require water and sewer system upgrades. The group hopes to begin construction next spring, though questions remain about funding and who would pay for the upgrades.

canada.summary: There’s little point passing laws establishing fixed-election dates if premiers and prime ministers can disregard them whenever it suits their political interests.

canada.title: N.B. Power won't disconnect customers struggling with winter power bills
canada.summary: N.B. Power is continuing its moratorium on electricity disconnection for vulnerable customers again this year. N.B. Power says that by the time the moratorium ended its first winter in March, more than 450 customers were at risk of disconnection.

canada.title: Largest emissions spike in decade further sets back climate goals in Toronto area
canada.summary: A more polluting energy grid and rising demand for gas heating during a colder winter drove the largest annual spike in planet-warming emissions in at least a decade across the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area, a new report found, putting the region further off track to its climate goals.

canada.title: Woman dead after fire breaks out at southwest Calgary apartment building

canada.title: Blood Tribe welcomes manslaughter charges against 3 Calgary police officers

canada.title: Sexton Lumber bringing N.L.'s largest sawmill back online
canada.summary: Employees are arriving back at the Sexton Lumber sawmill in Bloomfield, as operations ramp up in the wake of a damaging fire on Oct. 29. Owner Kevin Sexton hopes to have the full crew back to work next week.
